content.short: ChainSafe Unity SDK is an open-source gaming SDK that connects Unity-based games to the blockchain.
content.description: ChainSafe Unity SDK gives Unity game developers access to ChainSafe's web3 infrastructure to build games that rely on decentralized protocols. The ChainSafe development platform centers on creating and supporting web3 applications, and the Unity SDK extends this by providing secure, efficient means to integrate blockchain functionality and NFT assets directly into Unity projects. This enables developers to leverage proven web3 tooling to bring decentralized gameplay experiences to life while maintaining performance and reliability.
content.meta: ChainSafe Unity SDK enables Unity games to use ChainSafe's web3 infrastructure. Discover ChainSafe Unity SDK and other Web3 apps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
